description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which extends Fragment and is used to display log data inside a ScrollView with a custom LogView widget. It handles view creation, layout setup, and text change listening to facilitate log display in an Android app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains a LogView for outputting log data, managing view layout, and handling text change interaction.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView instances, sets layout parameters, padding, and styles, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate views and add a text change listener to auto-scroll when log text updates.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
